Resource Profile: NoImplVitalSignsObservationPulse

Official URL: http://dips.no/fhir/R4/StructureDefinition/NoImplVitalSignsObservationPulse Version: 0.1.0
Draft as of 2024-12-02 Computable Name: NoImplVitalSignsObservationPulse

The rate and associated attributes for a pulse.

To record details about the rate and associated attributes for a pulse.

Usages:

  • Examples for this Profile: Observation/noimpl-pulse-rate

You can also check for usages in the FHIR IG Statistics
